summary.zh: 组织可复用的前端组件架构
summary.en: Component patterns for React, Vue, and Svelte projects.

description.zh: 梳理 React、Vue 与 Svelte 的组件写法，涵盖样式方案、组合方式与组件接口设计。适合搭建组件库、制定前端规范，或重构难维护的组件。
description.en: Covers component patterns across React, Vue, and Svelte, including styling approaches, composition, and component API design. Useful for building a component library, setting frontend conventions, or refactoring messy components.
